title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $300 on the Mova V70 Robot Vacuum & Mop
excerpt: Grab a robot vacuum deal before the Prime Day rush.
content_html:
SAVE $300: As of Sept. 30, the Mova V70 robot vacuum and mop is marked down to $999 at Amazon. That's $300 off the regular list price of $,1299.

Credit: Mova

$999 at Amazon
$1,299 Save $300

If you've always fancied a robot vacuum to do your dirty work around the home, but you've never fancied the premium price tags, October Prime Day is your chance to strike. And you don't even have to wait until the event starts.

The official two-day sale event is a week away — launching properly on Oct. 6 — but discounts are already live. For instance, Amazon has already marked down the Mova V70 robot vacuum and mop by a generous 23%.

Mashable Trend Report

As of Sept. 30, the Mova V70 robot vacuum and mop is down to $999. It's usually listed at $1,299, so you'll save $300 before Prime Day has even kicked off. According to price tracker camelcamelcamel, that's the lowest-ever price at Amazon. In fact, it's the first time this model has been discounted by a single dollar.

There's a reason this one's usually listed at a premium price. It's no ordinary robot vacuum and mop combo. It has an industry-first innovation known as MaxiReachX, a clever extension of both the side brush and mop that gives you greater cleaning coverage on both carpets and hard floors. It also has powerful "hurricane" suction, app control, AI-powered obstacle avoidance, and StepMaster tech that help it climb thresholds up to 3.54 inches high.

Pick up the Mova V70 robot vacuum and mop for just $999.99 and save $300 as part of early Prime Day deals.
